summary: Code-review verification of the Partner Expo app (active.tsx) secondary-action buttons overflow fix. Expo native-only screen, not served on preview, so verified via source inspection + TypeScript compile check.

code_review_findings.container_line_667: View uses flexDirection:row, gap:10, flexWrap:'wrap' — allows buttons to wrap to next line on narrow widths instead of overflowing.
code_review_findings.reject_button_line_669: Pressable testID=reject-<code> uses outlineBtn + flex:1, minWidth:130, paddingHorizontal:8. Icon size=15. Text has numberOfLines={1}, fontSize:12, fontWeight:700, flexShrink:1. Label 'Reject Job' is short — fits comfortably.
code_review_findings.reschedule_button_line_672: Pressable testID=reschedule-<code> same styles: flex:1, minWidth:130, paddingHorizontal:8, icon=15. Text 'Request Reschedule' has numberOfLines={1} + flexShrink:1 + fontSize:12 — will be truncated with ellipsis if space insufficient instead of spilling outside border.
code_review_findings.outlineBtn_line_523: height:44, borderRadius:6, borderWidth:1, alignItems:center, justifyContent:center, flexDirection:row, gap:6. Border contains children because text has flexShrink:1 + numberOfLines:1.
code_review_findings.verdict: Overflow fix is correctly implemented. On narrow phones (<~340dp usable row width), the two buttons wrap to two rows (flexWrap:'wrap' + minWidth:130) rather than squeezing text out. On medium widths, flexShrink:1 + numberOfLines:1 forces ellipsis truncation within the border. No regression — the change is purely style/props on existing Pressable/Text.

compile_check: npx tsc --noEmit returned no errors for active.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix looks correct and minimal. Optional enhancement: consider ellipsizeMode='tail' explicitly on the Text (defaults to tail, so not strictly needed), and shortening label to 'Reschedule' on very narrow devices to avoid ellipsis — purely nice-to-have.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Partner app (Expo) is not served on preview port 3000 (CRA web_panel is). Native-only Expo screens are verified via code review + tsc, as done in previous iterations (e.g. 229). active.tsx lines 667-674 contain the Reject + Reschedule outline buttons with overflow-safe styling.
